visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of game/promo tiles with image, optional NEW badge or jackpot band, title, details and CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: Green rgb(170,186,10) heading strip with white H2; below, white background with a 2-column grid of shadowed game tiles (left, about 2/3) beside a right rail of 4 stacked promo images (right, about 1/3).

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: [image | text]. Text: optional lead paragraph before the heading (short text such as NEW becomes a corner badge; anything else, e.g. a jackpot amount, becomes a band over the image bottom), heading (title), description, optional draw details, CTA link as the last paragraph
contentPattern.variantDescriptor: White shadowed game tiles in 2-column grid, image top with optional jackpot band/NEW corner badge, blue pill CTA

usage: Grid of game/promo tiles: image top with an optional NEW corner badge or jackpot band, title, description, draw details and a pill CTA.
reuseGuidance: Author a lead paragraph before the heading for a badge (short text such as NEW) or jackpot band (amount). Use base cards for plain image/text cards.
